items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Red Hot Bergen would play his trumpet over the phone for you.

ctx.x: He used that little amplifier. Yeah. I saw him with the banjo. He was doing pretty good on the banjo. Yeah. He used to call me up on the telephone. I used to listen to him play his banjo. Over the telephone.

Mm-hmm. Well, I know people that... Red Hot Bergen would play his trumpet over the phone for you. Yeah. He'd play West End Blues or something like that. Did you ever play around Magazine Street and Chapitoulas and that was there? Mm-hmm.
I played on Chapitoulas at Heflers.
